name: edgeview-launcher
description: EdgeView Launcher - Desktop client for ZEDEDA edge devices

scripts.build:mac: npm run build:backend:mac && APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY='EdgeView Dev' tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:backend:mac: VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -ldflags="-X main.Version=$VERSION" -o src-tauri/binaries/edgeview-backend-aarch64-apple-darwin ./cmd/edgeview-backend
scripts.build:backend:windows: VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags="-X main.Version=$VERSION" -o src-tauri/binaries/edgeview-backend-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe ./cmd/edgeview-backend
scripts.build:backend:linux: VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags="-X main.Version=$VERSION" -o src-tauri/binaries/edgeview-backend-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu ./cmd/edgeview-backend
scripts.build:windows: npm run build:backend:windows && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:backend:linux && tauri build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
